newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia Sengkang project financing pact signed.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Sengkang project financing pact signed.

text.p: The $178.875 million project financing facilities for the Sengkang Gasfield and Power Projects were signed on Monday in Jakarta with 11 international banks, the arrangers said.
They said the Sengkang Power Project is the first natural gas-fired combined cycle independent power producer (IPP) project in Indonesia.
Project shareholders and sponsors are Energy Equity Corp, Tenneco Energy, a division of Tenneco Inc and PT Trihasra Sarana Jaya Purnama.
The financing is split into two facilities.

Tranche A consists of an approximately $112.9 million 14-year limited recourse facility with 90 percent export credit insurance cover provided by Geschaftsstelle fur die Exportrisikogarantie (ERG) and an approximately $25.5 million 14-year uncovered limited recourse facility to PT Energi Sengkang (PTES).
Tranche B is a $40.5 million 10.5 years uncovered limited recourse facility to Energy Equity Tenneco (Sengkang) Pty Ltd.
The banks and their respective commitments (divided pro rata across the three facilities) are listed below.
Arrangers, with $24.4375 million each, are BZW Asia Ltd and Union Bank of Switzerland.
Co-arrangers, with $16.5 million each, are Bayerische Landesbank and Credit Suisse.
Lead managers, with $16.5 million each, are Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, Bayerische Vereinsbank, Credit Lyonnais and Royal Bank of Scotland.
Managers are Toronto Dominion Bank, with $13 million, and Fuji Bank and LTCB Merchant Bank (Singapore), with $9 million each.
BZW and UBS have fully underwritten a $141.3 million long-dated interest swap facility, and were joined by Australia and New Zealand Banking Group and Bayerische Vereinsbank as swap providers.
